findings.text: Activate expects dedicated smart speakers to serve as a “trojan horse” for delivering AI into the home and expects digital assistants to become ubiquitous across a broad set of devices.
findings.evidence:
To be relevant in the early stages of the digital assistant battle, each of the tech companies has started with a dedicated smart speaker — essentially a trojan horse to deliver AI into the home
Ultimately, we expect that the hardware will become a commodity, and the digital assistant will be ubiquitous through a broad set of devices
findings.section_title: Smart Speaker Battles are about the Great Digital Assistant Wars
